parties.respondent: M/s Arfat Petrochemicals Pvt. Ltd. & Ors.

summary: The appeals arise from the Rajasthan High Court's judgment allowing a writ petition filed by M/s Arfat Petrochemicals Pvt. Ltd., which set aside the State Cabinet's decision to cancel land allotment permissions granted to the company in Kota. The dispute centers on the legality of the cancellation of industrial land allotments originally made to J.K. Synthetics Ltd. in 1958 and later transferred. The State of Rajasthan, RIICO, and workers unions challenged the High Court’s decision. The core issues include compliance with Rajasthan Industrial Areas Allotment Rules, 1959, particularly regarding land use, transfer restrictions, and lawful delegation of authority. The Court examined whether the transfer of leasehold rights and subsequent industrial development adhered to statutory conditions. The appeals were filed to determine the validity of the High Court's intervention in quashing executive orders related to industrial land cancellation.
legal_provisions_cited: Rajasthan Enterprises Single Window Enabling and Clearance Rules, 2011
final_judgment: Leave granted; appeals allowed in part with directions to assess compliance with transfer conditions under the 1959 Rules and ensure due process in cancellation decisions, while preserving the rights of bona fide industrial development subject to regulatory conformity.
